recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source action is needed for FHIR-17735 unless FM wants a new substantive change to model dispensed medication separately from the existing productOrService drug-code field.
issue_request: FHIR-17735 was Published with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. Pharmacy asked where to put the medication actually dispensed in a Claim when it differs from the referenced MedicationRequest; the resolution said item.billCode was the designated field, that it had been renamed productOrService, and that Drug Code alias/short text should make the placement clear.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-17735-tagged source commit was found. The apparent application came through the same FM cleanup family: afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a listed FHIR-17924 and FHIR-19283, changed Claim source from billcode to productOrService, and current Claim StructureDefinition source retains that result.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Claim.item.productOrService, Claim.item.detail.productOrService, and Claim.item.detail.subDetail.productOrService all describe billing, service, product, or drug codes and carry Drug Code aliases; the pharmacy medication example uses item.productOrService with an RxNorm coding. FHIR-19283 and FHIR-17924 already have combined-branch reconciliation commits, and community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope Claim source already satisfies the issue resolution and no Claim-family current source still uses billCode/billcode.
